The '''Great Evacuation''' was the grandiose name given to the escape from [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] by the ''[[Star's Delight]]''. Coined by [[Dynba Tesc]], the Great Evacuation was organized by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Whistler]] to free the crew of the ''Star's Delight'' and several [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]-sympathetic individuals.
